type: Exploratory extension; Qwen idle-gap test results already observed; original plan/results retained.
rationale: Known fixed body padding makes application request-sized records visible; same-service calls serialize. Test whether public-protocol eventization can recover the useful event structure without true call intervals.
fixed_rules: Per destination: upward encrypted record >=4096 bytes triggers a transaction; first two are public MCP setup; remaining groups end at last downward record >=4096 before next trigger. No true call data read.
fitting: Same TRAIN/validation/test, feature vectors, LR/RF and TRAIN-only unlabelled GMM as first analysis. Validation selection before new test prediction. All five arms and both models; no new superiority p-values.
scope: Still supplies episode-associated connection bundles; not task discovery or unrestricted H2 demultiplexing.
